devdoc.details: It is not recommended to use service contract directly, should be used only through router (like IporProtocolRouter or PowerTokenRouter)

pwTokenCancelCooldown().details: The function calls the `cancelCooldown` function of the PowerToken contract to cancel the cooldown.

pwTokenCooldown(uint256).details: The function ensures that the `pwTokenAmount` is greater than zero.The function calls the `cooldown` function of the PowerToken contract to initiate the cooldown.Reverts if the `pwTokenAmount` is not greater than zero.

params.pwTokenAmount: The amount of Power Tokens to be put into cooldown, represented with 18 decimals.

redeemPwToken(address).details: The function calls the `redeem` function of the PowerToken contract to redeem Power Tokens.

params.transferTo: The address to which the Staked Tokens will be transferred.

stakeGovernanceTokenToPowerTokenAndDeleg.details: The function ensures that the `beneficiary` address is valid and the `governanceTokenAmount` is greater than zero.The function also requires that the length of the `lpTokens` array is equal to the length of the `pwTokenAmounts` array.For each liquidity pool token in `lpTokens`, the function creates an `UpdatePwToken` structure to be used for updating the power tokens in the Liquidity Mining contract.The function checks if the total amount of power tokens to be delegated is less or equal to the amount of staked governance tokens.The function calls the `addGovernanceTokenInternal` function of the PowerToken contract to update the staked governance tokens for the `beneficiary`.The function transfers the governance tokens from the sender to the PowerToken contract for staking.The function calls the `delegateInternal` function of the PowerToken contract to delegate power tokens to the `beneficiary`.Finally, the function calls the `addPwTokensInternal` function of the Liquidity Mining contract to update the staked power tokens.Reverts if any of the requirements is not met or if the transfer of governance tokens fails.

params.beneficiary: The address on whose behalf the governance tokens will be staked and power tokens will be delegated.
params.governanceTokenAmount: The amount of governance tokens to be staked, represented with 18 decimals.
params.lpTokens: An array of addresses representing the liquidity pool tokens.
params.pwTokenAmounts: An array of amounts of power tokens to be delegated corresponding to each liquidity pool token.

stakeLpTokensToLiquidityMining(address,a.details: This function allows the caller to stake their LP tokens on behalf of another address (`beneficiary`).Both `lpTokens` and `lpTokenAmounts` arrays must have the same length.The `beneficiary` address must not be the zero address.The function ensures that the provided LP token addresses are valid and the amounts to be staked are greater than zero.The function transfers the LP tokens from the caller's address to the LiquidityMining contract.Finally, the function calls the `addLpTokens` function of the LiquidityMining contract to update the staked LP tokens.Reverts if any of the requirements is not met or if the transfer of LP tokens fails.

params.beneficiary: The address on behalf of which the LP tokens are being staked.
params.lpTokenMaxAmounts: An array of corresponding LP token amounts to be staked which represent maximal amount to stake if balance of sender is lower this balance is transferred, represented with 18 decimals.
params.lpTokens: An array of LP token addresses to be staked.

unstakeLpTokensFromLiquidityMining(addre.details: Both `lpTokens` and `lpTokenAmounts` arrays must have the same length.The function ensures that the provided LP token addresses are valid and the amounts to be unstaked are greater than zero.The function calls the `removeLpTokens` function of the LiquidityMining contract to update the unstaked LP tokens.Finally, the function transfers the unstaked LP tokens from the LiquidityMining contract to the specified address.Reverts if any of the requirements is not met or if the transfer of LP tokens fails.

params.lpTokenAmounts: An array of corresponding LP token amounts to be unstaked, represented with 18 decimals.
params.lpTokens: An array of LP token addresses to be unstaked.
params.transferTo: The address to which the unstaked LP tokens will be transferred.

pwTokenCancelCooldown().notice: Cancels the active cooldown for the sender.

pwTokenCooldown(uint256).notice: Initiates a cooldown period for the specified amount of Power Tokens.

redeemPwToken(address).notice: Redeems Power Tokens and transfers the corresponding Staked Tokens to the specified address.

stakeGovernanceTokenToPowerTokenAndDeleg.notice: Stakes a specified amount of governance tokens and delegates power tokens to a specific beneficiary.

stakeLpTokensToLiquidityMining(address,a.notice: Stakes the specified amounts of LP tokens into the LiquidityMining contract.

unstakeLpTokensFromLiquidityMining(addre.notice: Unstakes the specified amounts of LP tokens from the LiquidityMining contract and transfers them to the specified address.
